flagSources.description: Read flags from one or more files (one '--flag=value' per line, '#' comments OK).
Read each listed flag from FLAGS_<name>; missing env vars are an error.
Same as --fromenv but silently skip flags whose env var is unset.
Tolerate '--name1=...' even when no flag with that name exists (useful for shared flagfiles across binaries).

helpVariants.description: Flags whose name or description matches.
Print the build banner and exit.

flags.name: abandon_wal
flags.description: The id of a lost WAL directory that owns a server directory on an object store: the server starts from its last snapshot, and the commits that only that WAL holds are lost.

flags.name: auth_api_key
flags.description: Static HTTP ApiKey credential as id:key (empty = ApiKey rejected).

flags.name: auth_bearer_token
flags.description: Static HTTP Bearer token (empty = Bearer rejected).

flags.name: auth_timeout
flags.description: Max time from connect to authenticated, per connection (0 = off). pg: covers TLS+startup+auth; http: the request-header read deadline.

flags.name: cpu_threads
flags.description: Executor pool size at process start. 0 = let server auto-detect from cpu_count. `SET GLOBAL threads = N` resizes the pool at runtime.

flags.name: hba_config
flags.description: Path to the host-based authentication config file. Empty (the default) uses <server directory>/pg_hba.conf; a relative path is resolved against the server directory.

flags.name: http_body_timeout
flags.description: Max time to read one HTTP request body.

flags.name: http_cors_origins
flags.description: CORS allow-origin list for the HTTP/ES API: comma-separated origins or '*' (empty disables CORS). Echoes an allowed Origin and answers preflight OPTIONS.

flags.name: idle_session_timeout
flags.description: Close a session idle (between requests) longer than this. Drives the HTTP keep-alive idle timeout.

flags.name: io_threads
flags.description: IO threads for HTTP and pg-wire connections and for timers (0 = one per physical core).

flags.name: listen
flags.description: Listener URL(s), comma-separated or repeated (last-wins). Each is one listener: postgres://host:port[?sslmode=...], http(s)://host:port?api=mcp&api=otel (es needs a listener of its own), postgres:///path/to.sock (unix). A postgres listener needs an explicit port, http(s) defaults to 80/443; a path after the port is ignored.

flags.name: max_connections
flags.description: Max concurrent client connections across all listeners (0 = unlimited). Over-cap connections get 53300 (pg) / 503 (http) then close. Per-listener override via ?max_connections=.

flags.name: max_temp_directory_size
flags.description: The most disk space the temporary directory may take, such as 100GiB; its copies of evicted blocks take half of it at most. Empty is 90% of the disk space available where it lies.

flags.name: pg_max_message_bytes
flags.description: Maximum size of a single pg-wire message (statement text / bound parameter value). Bulk data should use COPY, which streams.

flags.name: remap_executable
flags.description: Copy the server's machine code into anonymous huge-page memory at startup, so the first queries after a cold start pay no code page faults and the code runs from huge pages. Off, the machine code is locked in memory instead, or pre-read where locking is not permitted, and perf can symbolize it, which it cannot for anonymous code. Read-only data is pre-read either way. On by default in Release builds, and off in the others.

flags.name: require_existing
flags.description: Refuse to start when the server directory holds no server, instead of creating a new one.

flags.name: server_directory
flags.description: Path to the server directory. A positional argument, if given, takes precedence.

flags.name: temp_directory
flags.description: Local directory for the temporary files of queries that spill to disk and the copies of evicted blocks of object store files, which the server reads again after a restart. Empty uses <server directory>/temp; a server directory on an object store needs it.

flags.name: tls_ca
flags.description: Default PEM CA bundle to verify client certificates (sslmode=verify-ca/verify-full).

flags.name: tls_cert
flags.description: Default PEM server certificate chain for TLS listeners (a listener may override with ?cert=).

flags.name: tls_ciphers
flags.description: OpenSSL TLS 1.2 cipher list (forward-secret AEAD, Mozilla intermediate); TLS 1.3 suites are fixed by OpenSSL.

flags.name: tls_groups
flags.description: TLS key-exchange groups, colon-separated.

flags.name: tls_key
flags.description: Default PEM private key for --tls_cert.

flags.name: tls_min_version
flags.description: Minimum TLS version: 1.2 or 1.3 (legacy TLS is not supported).

flags.name: wal_directory
flags.description: Local directory for the write-ahead log (WAL) of the commits since the last snapshot. Empty uses <server directory>/wal; a server directory on an object store needs it.

flags.name: log_level
flags.description: Minimum log severity at process start: trace | debug | info | warning | error | fatal. Override at runtime with `SET logging_level = '<value>'`.

flags.name: log_path
flags.description: Path used by --log_storage, when it takes one. Its meaning is storage-dependent (for 'file', the log file or directory); ignored by storages that take no path, such as 'stdout' and 'memory'.

flags.name: log_storage
flags.description: Log destination at process start. Accepted values: 'stdout' (default; systemd/container log drivers capture it), 'memory' (queryable via SELECT * FROM sdb_logs()), or 'file' (uses --log_path). Override at runtime with `CALL enable_logging(storage='<value>', storage_path='<path>')`.
